verdict.reasons: Core identity, branding, and scene context are correct. However, the image violates the packaging_not_used_as_hardware condition: a white tape strip is visibly extending from the bottom edge of the commercial carton roll and resting on top of the installed black irrigation lateral, functioning as a physical component rather than merely representing the product. This makes the product role implausible and the irrigation geometry technically contradictory.
